description: Get a high-level summary of a target: subscription tier, scan history, and vulnerability counts from the most recent scan. Specify which target with target_id (or domain); defaults to the only accessible target if the key can act on just one.

domain.description: Convenience alias for target_id: an active target's domain, resolved server-side.

target_id.description: Which target to summarize. Optional when the key can act on a single target; required otherwise.

name: get_domain_summary
